newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Friday it reduced its rating on Talbot Inc to neutral from buy after comparable-store sales gains for March fell short of its expectations.
-- Rodman said the one-percent gain over sales in stores open more than a year was below its expectation of a two-percent gain.

-- Talbots will most likely experience the same factors in April that were in effect in March, prompting Rodman to reduce its estimate for same-store sales in April to a decline of 15 percent from an expectation of a one-percent decline.

-- Rodman also cut its earnings estimate for the first quarter to $0.55 from $0.65, versus $0.62 last year. The earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 was also cut to $2.08 from $2.15 and the estimate for 1999 to $2.48 from $2.55.
-- Talbots is a women's specialty apparel retailer.
-- Its shares were off 1 Friday at 28-3/8.
